The tabs of Wren's windows, as the shell describes them (src/page/ext_api.odin, ext_tabs.odin). A tab's url and title are given only with the tabs permission, a host grant for its URL, or for the extension's own pages. create, update and remove act from a task of the loop of their own, then answer.

Gate: no permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab. Source: api/ext_tabs.widl.

#Methods and properties

MemberResultStatusGate
query(optional QueryInfo queryInfo)Tab[]host
get(i64 tabId)Tabhost
getCurrent()TabhostThe tab of the calling page; undefined for a popup or the background.
create(CreateProperties createProperties)Tabhost
update(optional i64 tabId, UpdateProperties updateProperties)TabhostNo tabId: the selected tab of the current window.
remove(TabIds tabIds)voidhost
sendMessage(i64 tabId, any message, optional MessageSendOptions options)anyhostTo the content scripts of the extension in the tab (one frame with frameId) that listen to runtime.onMessage. The first answer wins; with none, "Could not establish connection. Receiving end does not exist.".
connect(i64 tabId, optional TabConnectInfo connectInfo)PortrealmA port to the content scripts of the extension in the tab (one frame with frameId) that listen to runtime.onConnect.

#Types

#TabStatus

A string: "unloaded", "loading", "complete". chrome.tabs.TabStatus names them.

One URL or match pattern, or a list of them.

One of: string or string[].

One of: i64 or i64[].
